sentences.en: Craft must have clothes, but truth loves to go naked.
sentences.zh: 技艺需要包装，但真理喜欢裸露。

sentences.en: She learned the craft of basket weaving from her grandmother.
sentences.zh: 她从祖母那里学会了编篮子的手艺。

sentences.en: "What craft do you know?" the wizard asked the youth.
sentences.zh: ‘你懂什么行当？’法师问那个年轻人。

senses.zh: 工艺，手艺；船，艇，飞行器；诡计，骗术；行业，职业；手工艺品
